purpose: NestJS CanActivate guard verifying authenticated user has customer capability. Checks request.user.id (server-side session only), queries customer_accounts table via TenantContextService with RLS context, returns true if account exists or throws 403 Forbidden. Used as @UseGuards(CustomerGuard) decorator on customer-only endpoints.
invariants: Guard executes during request processing, after SessionValidationMiddleware
userId must originate exclusively from server-side session (request.user.id set by middleware only, never client-supplied)
Each guard invocation opens a new transaction via TenantContextService.querySingleWithContext()
RLS context enforced at database level; guard checks customer_accounts table membership
If customer account exists: attach to request.user.customerAccount, return true
If customer account missing: throw ForbiddenException (403)
If database error or unexpected exception: throw UnauthorizedException (401, fail-closed)
No authentication means request.user.id is undefined; throw UnauthorizedException before database query
known_limitations: Tests mock TenantContextService; actual RLS enforcement not validated in guard tests (delegated to integration tests)
Does not validate phone_verified or other customer attributes (only checks account existence)
Does not implement rate limiting or re-authentication after session expiry (session validation delegated to middleware)
Guard does not check whether user has merchant capability; customer and merchant are independent
caveats: TESTED_WITH: Jest unit tests mocking TenantContextService; mocked return value controls test behavior
NOT_TESTED_WITH: Actual TenantContextService with real PostgreSQL queries (integration responsibility)
NOT_TESTED_WITH: Actual request.user payload from Better Auth session (session validation middleware responsibility)
ASSUMPTION: ExecutionContext.switchToHttp().getRequest() returns Express Request with user property (NestJS framework contract)
ASSUMPTION: TenantContextService throws ForbiddenException if account not found (contract from service; guard does not catch ForbiddenException)
